decks.notes: This Aggro Goblin deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a swarm of Goblin creatures. It utilizes cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to bring out powerful Goblin creatures like Goblin Warchief and Siege-Gang Commander to deal damage rapidly. The deck also includes removal spells like Smother and Gempalm Incinerator to control the board and ensure the Goblins can keep attacking without being blocked. The key strategy is to play aggressively and efficiently to defeat the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to put multiple Goblins into play quickly, alongside support cards like Goblin Warchief to reduce costs and increase speed, the focus is on building a strong board presence and dealing out damage efficiently. With cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Goblin Piledriver to deliver powerful blows, the goal is to maintain a high tempo and put pressure on the opponent to win the game swiftly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using enchantments like Wild Growth and Serra's Sanctum, while also drawing cards with Enchantress's Presence and Mirri's Guile. The deck aims to create a lockout situation using cards like Solitary Confinement and Parallax Wave, while also having the option to win the game through Opalescence turning enchantments into creatures. The deck also includes removal like Seal of Cleansing and Swords to Plowshares to control the board and protect the combo pieces.

The deck focuses on using the combo of Stifle and Phyrexian Dreadnought to quickly deploy a 12/12 creature for only one mana. The deck also includes various spells to control the game, such as Counterspell and Daze, as well as cantrips like Portent and Vision Charm to dig for key pieces. By disrupting the opponent's strategy and quickly ramping up a massive threat, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The focus of this Mono Blue Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through counter spells, bounce effects, and land destruction while drawing cards to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to delay the opponent's threats with counterspells like Mana Leak and Force Spike, alongside bounce effects like Chain of Vapor, ultimately establishing control with cards like Powder Keg and Parallax Tide. The inclusion of land destruction like Dust Bowl and utility lands like Quicksand offer additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of resources with cards like Fact or Fiction and Accumulated Knowledge.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and outlasting opponents by using creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects and mana acceleration. It utilizes cards like Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures and Winter Orb to disrupt opponent's mana base. The deck aims to create advantageous board states through cards like Opposition and Tradewind Rider, while also generating card advantage through cards like Sylvan Library. The key strategy is to maintain board presence, disrupt opponent's strategies, and eventually overwhelm them with powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play creatures like Terravore and Anurid Brushhopper while utilizing cards like Weathered Wayfarer and Sylvan Safekeeper to protect them. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Meddling Mage and Armageddon. The inclusion of land destruction cards such as Wasteland and Rishadan Port further adds to the aggressive and disruptive nature of the deck. Additionally, the deck has access to card advantage and token generation through cards like Call of the Herd and Sylvan Library.

The main focus of this deck is to rapidly ramp up mana production using cards like Wild Growth and Fyndhorn Elves, and then overwhelm the opponent with large creatures like Blastoderm and Erhnam Djinn. It also aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Tangle Wire and Winter Orb, while maintaining board control with cards like Call of the Herd and Masticore. The inclusion of Nantuko Vigilante helps deal with any troublesome artifacts or enchantments the opponent may have, making sure the path is clear for the powerful stompy creatures to dominate the battlefield.

This deck focuses on quickly generating mana through Elves and Gaea's Cradle to play powerful creatures like Multani's Acolyte and Deranged Hermit. Survival of the Fittest is used to tutor specific creatures while Winter Orb disrupts opponent's mana base. Rishadan Port can be used to control opponent's resources. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive creature strategy, utilizing mana acceleration and efficient creature abilities to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent.

The deck revolves around utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly get powerful creatures onto the battlefield while controlling the opponent's resources with cards like Winter's Grasp, Thermokarst, and Sphere of Resistance. The mana base is focused on ramping up quickly with cards like Mox Diamond and Terravore. The deck also includes removal options like Pyroclasm and Naturalize to deal with threats as needed. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupt their game plan with control elements.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counter spells and card draw, using Psychatog as a win condition. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building a strong board presence with Psychatog, which can quickly grow in power by discarding cards. The key strategy is to efficiently control the opponent's threats and resources, while leveraging Psychatog's ability to close out games quickly. Ultimately, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through card advantage and strategic play.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells, removing threats with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, and utilizing card draw to maintain card advantage. Psychatog serves as a win condition by growing in power based on the number of cards in the player's graveyard. The deck also utilizes land destruction with cards like Wasteland and Cataclysm to disrupt opponent's mana base. The deck aims to control the game's pace while building up resources and eventually closing out the game with powerful threats like Exalted Angel and Psychatog.

The main idea of this deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently through a combination of cheap, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Grim Lavamancer, Ball Lightning, and Mogg Fanatic alongside powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero before they are able to stabilize or mount a defense. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Cursed Scroll also allows for additional damage to be dealt over time, ensuring a swift victory.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful creature with minimal cost. The deck includes card draw and manipulation spells to help find the necessary pieces of the combo, as well as countermagic to protect it from disruption. It aims to execute the combo efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with a large, hard-hitting creature early in the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Survival of the Fittest and other discard spells to control the board while efficiently tutoring creatures to maintain card advantage. The key strategy is to constantly disrupt the opponent's strategy through targeted hand disruption and removal while assembling a toolbox of creatures for various situations. The deck aims to grind out incremental advantages and eventually overwhelm the opponent with a well-timed threat or combo. The deck's synergy lies in its ability to adapt to different matchups and constantly answer threats while building towards a win condition.

This deck focuses on using creatures with abilities that can disrupt the opponent's strategy while also utilizing the Survival of the Fittest card to tutor for specific creatures to suit the situation. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Enduring Renewal allows for further control over the board and potential combos with recurring creatures. The mana base is designed to support the diverse range of creatures and spells, emphasizing the importance of ramping up to powerful plays with cards like Gaea's Cradle. Overall, the deck is centered around maintaining board control and outmaneuvering the opponent through strategic creature choices and utilizing various interactions between cards.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cycling cards such as Renewed Faith and Eternal Dragon to generate card advantage and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to maintain board control with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God, while also dealing incremental damage with Lightning Rift. Astral Slide provides utility by cycling creatures in and out of play, while Decree of Justice helps close out the game with a swarm of flying tokens. Overall, the deck aims to constantly cycle through its cards to manipulate the game in its favor.

This deck focuses on aggressively controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress. The key strategy is to continuously apply pressure with efficient creatures like Grim Lavamancer and Ravenous Rats while also generating value with cards like Call of the Herd and Sylvan Library. The deck aims to outpace opponents with a combination of disruption, card advantage, and quick threats while utilizing a variety of removal spells like Terminate to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is built to consistently cast spells and maximize the deck's potential.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Hermit Druid, Phyrexian Devourer, and Triskelion to win the game. The deck plays a lot of mana sources and creature tutors to find and play the combo pieces as soon as possible. It also includes disruption like Duress and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo. The deck is focused on efficiently executing its game plan and winning through a powerful combo in the early turns of the game, making it a fast and aggressive combo deck in the Premodern format.

The key concept of this deck is to flood the board with aggressive Goblin creatures and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed and power. Utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to put pressure on the opponent early on, and cards like Gempalm Incinerator to deal damage and draw cards, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and quickly defeat the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also includes some removal spells like Terminate and Smother to deal with threats and keep the aggression going.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the board with spells like Vindicate and Swords to Plowshares while using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures. The deck also utilizes disruptive cards like Duress and Sphere of Resistance to slow down the opponent's game plan. The land base is built to support the deck's control elements, with Wasteland and Rishadan Port to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent with its efficient removal and powerful creatures, ultimately grinding out a win.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with land destruction and control spells while using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures. By limiting the opponent's resources and slowing them down, the deck aims to establish board control and overwhelm them with efficient threats. The inclusion of cards like Winter's Grasp and Naturalize helps to deal with opposing threats, while Sphere of Resistance disrupts the opponent's spells. With a mix of disruptive elements and powerful creatures, this deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and come out on top.

The main deck focuses on utilizing Oath of Druids to control the board and bring out powerful creatures like Terravore. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Swords to Plowshares, while also maintaining card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library. The deck also includes land destruction cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to further hinder the opponent's resources. Overall, the deck seeks to dominate the battlefield through a combination of control elements and efficient creature deployment.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through disruptive cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland, while also utilizing the Oath of Druids combo with Terravore to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's resources and play into a control strategy with creature beatdown as its win condition. The inclusion of cards like Naturalize and Earthquake provides additional utility and versatility in dealing with different threats. Overall, the deck focuses on establishing board presence and outvaluing the opponent in a premodern 1 vs 1 setting.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces needed to cast Replenish, bringing back powerful enchantments such as Opalescence and Parallax Wave to overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards to search for the combo pieces, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and provide mana acceleration. The deck aims to control the board while setting up its combo, ultimately utilizing the synergy between enchantments to create an unbeatable board state and win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo of Replenish and Opalescence to quickly and efficiently bring back enchantments from the graveyard and turn them into creatures with power and toughness equal to their converted mana cost. The deck also includes control elements such as Mana Leak and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect the combo pieces. By efficiently cycling through the deck with cards like Frantic Search and Intuition, the goal is to establish a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent quickly.

The deck focuses on using Stasis to lock down the opponent's resources and prevent them from untapping their lands, while leveraging additional control elements like Counterspell and Chain of Vapor to maintain board control. The deck aims to stall the game until it can assemble a combo win condition, such as using Black Vise to deal damage to the opponent each turn or utilizing Claws of Gix to sacrifice Stasis for advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition through efficient card draw and manipulation.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly bring out Phyrexian Dreadnought, either by countering opponent's threats or efficiently drawing through the deck with cantrips. Stifle is used to prevent the triggered ability of Phyrexian Dreadnought from activating, allowing for a powerful 12/12 creature to hit the battlefield for only one mana. The deck aims to control the game early on and then overwhelm the opponent with a massive threat that is difficult to deal with.

The main idea of this deck is to assemble the "Stiflenought" combo by playing the Phyrexian Dreadnought and then using Stifle to counter the Dreadnought's triggered ability, allowing you to have a powerful 12/12 creature for just 1 mana. The deck also includes powerful blue spells like Counterspell, Gush, and Foil to control the game and protect your combo. Additionally, card draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Portent help you find the pieces you need to win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Phyrexian Dreadnought's ability to enter the battlefield with a massive power/toughness while using cards like Stifle, Foil, and Counterspell to protect it from removal or counter spells. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent before they can respond effectively. The addition of cards like Gush and Opt helps to dig deeper into the deck for key pieces, while Vision Charm and Portent provide additional card draw and manipulation. The Mishra's Factory serves as a backup win condition if the Dreadnought combo is unable to come together.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing powerful creatures and spells, while also maintaining a strong presence on the battlefield. By using cards like Recurring Nightmare, Cabal Therapy, Duress, and Survival of the Fittest, the player can disrupt their opponent's strategy and strategically choose which creatures to bring into play. By combining creatures like Ravenous Baloth, Genesis, and Deranged Hermit with mana ramp from Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots, the player can generate a steady stream of threats and card advantage to ultimately outvalue their opponent.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with land destruction spells to disrupt the opponent's mana base while quickly building a threatening board presence. The key strategy is to utilize cards like Armageddon and Terravore to devastating effect, while also using cards like Sylvan Library and Weathered Wayfarer to ensure consistent draws and access to necessary resources. By overwhelming the opponent with early aggression and removing their resources, this deck aims to secure a quick victory by overpowering the opponent before they can recover.
